Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Woh likhtay hain ke yeh ek shehar ka naam hai jis ki ek eent sonay ki hai, dusri chandi ki, us ke makanat, baghaat, mohallay waghera sab chandi sonay ke hain, kankar lulu aur jawaahir hain, mitti mushk hai, nehrein beh rahi hain, phal tayyar hain, koi rehnay sehnay wala nahin hai, dar-o-deewar khali hain, koi haan hoon karnay wala bhi nahin, yeh shehar jagah badalta rehta hai, kabhi Shaam mein, kabhi Yaman mein, kabhi Iraq mein, kabhi kahin, kabhi kahin.

Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Tera Rab ghaat mein hai, dekh raha hai, sun raha hai, samajh raha hai, waqt-e-muqarrara par har bure bhale ko neki ki jaza-o-saza de ga. Yeh sab log us ke paas jane wale, tan-tanha us ke samne khade hone wale hain aur woh adl-o-insaf ke sath in mein faisle kare ga aur har shakhs ko poora poora badla de ga jis ka woh mustahiq tha, woh zulm-o-jor se pak hai. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain is se murad tamam makhlooq hai is mein Shaf'a bhi hai aur Witr bhi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke makhlooq Shaf'a aur Allah Witr hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a subah ki namaz hai aur Witr Maghrib ki namaz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a se murad jor-jor aur Witr se murad Allah Azza-o-Jal jaise aasman, zameen, tari, khushki, jinn, ins, suraj, chand waghera. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Tera Rab ghaat mein hai, dekh raha hai, sun raha hai, samajh raha hai, waqt-e-muqarrara par har bure bhale ko neki ki jaza-o-saza de ga. Yeh sab log us ke paas jane wale, tan-tanha us ke samne khade hone wale hain aur woh adl-o-insaf ke sath in mein faisle kare ga aur har shakhs ko poora poora badla de ga jis ka woh mustahiq tha, woh zulm-o-jor se pak hai. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain is se murad tamam makhlooq hai is mein Shaf'a bhi hai aur Witr bhi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke makhlooq Shaf'a aur Allah Witr hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a subah ki namaz hai aur Witr Maghrib ki namaz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a se murad jor-jor aur Witr se murad Allah Azza-o-Jal jaise aasman, zameen, tari, khushki, jinn, ins, suraj, chand waghera. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Aayat (Wazkuro iz ja'alakum khulafa'a mim ba'di qawmi Noohin wa zadakum fil khalqi bastatan fazkuro ala'allahi la'allakum tuflihoon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 69) yani yaad karo ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein qoum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen par khalifa banaya hai aur tumhein jismani quwwat poori tarah di, tumhein chahiye ke Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasadi ban kar na raho. Aur jagah hai ke Aadiyon ne zameen mein nahaq sarkashi ki aur bol uthay ke hum se zyada quwwat wala aur kaun hai? Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain is se murad tamam makhlooq hai is mein Shaf'a bhi hai aur Witr bhi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke makhlooq Shaf'a aur Allah Witr hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a subah ki namaz hai aur Witr Maghrib ki namaz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a se murad jor-jor aur Witr se murad Allah Azza-o-Jal jaise aasman, zameen, tari, khushki, jinn, ins, suraj, chand waghera. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Aayat (Wazkuro iz ja'alakum khulafa'a mim ba'di qawmi Noohin wa zadakum fil khalqi bastatan fazkuro ala'allahi la'allakum tuflihoon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 69) yani yaad karo ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein qoum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen par khalifa banaya hai aur tumhein jismani quwwat poori tarah di, tumhein chahiye ke Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasadi ban kar na raho. Aur jagah hai ke Aadiyon ne zameen mein nahaq sarkashi ki aur bol uthay ke hum se zyada quwwat wala aur kaun hai? Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Woh likhtay hain ke yeh ek shehar ka naam hai jis ki ek eent sonay ki hai, dusri chandi ki, us ke makanat, baghaat, mohallay waghera sab chandi sonay ke hain, kankar lulu aur jawaahir hain, mitti mushk hai, nehrein beh rahi hain, phal tayyar hain, koi rehnay sehnay wala nahin hai, dar-o-deewar khali hain, koi haan hoon karnay wala bhi nahin, yeh shehar jagah badalta rehta hai, kabhi Shaam mein, kabhi Yaman mein, kabhi Iraq mein, kabhi kahin, kabhi kahin.

Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Aayat (Wazkuro iz ja'alakum khulafa'a mim ba'di qawmi Noohin wa zadakum fil khalqi bastatan fazkuro ala'allahi la'allakum tuflihoon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 69) yani yaad karo ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein qoum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen par khalifa banaya hai aur tumhein jismani quwwat poori tarah di, tumhein chahiye ke Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasadi ban kar na raho. Aur jagah hai ke Aadiyon ne zameen mein nahaq sarkashi ki aur bol uthay ke hum se zyada quwwat wala aur kaun hai? Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Woh likhtay hain ke yeh ek shehar ka naam hai jis ki ek eent sonay ki hai, dusri chandi ki, us ke makanat, baghaat, mohallay waghera sab chandi sonay ke hain, kankar lulu aur jawaahir hain, mitti mushk hai, nehrein beh rahi hain, phal tayyar hain, koi rehnay sehnay wala nahin hai, dar-o-deewar khali hain, koi haan hoon karnay wala bhi nahin, yeh shehar jagah badalta rehta hai, kabhi Shaam mein, kabhi Yaman mein, kabhi Iraq mein, kabhi kahin, kabhi kahin.

Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Tera Rab ghaat mein hai, dekh raha hai, sun raha hai, samajh raha hai, waqt-e-muqarrara par har bure bhale ko neki ki jaza-o-saza de ga. Yeh sab log us ke paas jane wale, tan-tanha us ke samne khade hone wale hain aur woh adl-o-insaf ke sath in mein faisle kare ga aur har shakhs ko poora poora badla de ga jis ka woh mustahiq tha, woh zulm-o-jor se pak hai. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Woh likhtay hain ke yeh ek shehar ka naam hai jis ki ek eent sonay ki hai, dusri chandi ki, us ke makanat, baghaat, mohallay waghera sab chandi sonay ke hain, kankar lulu aur jawaahir hain, mitti mushk hai, nehrein beh rahi hain, phal tayyar hain, koi rehnay sehnay wala nahin hai, dar-o-deewar khali hain, koi haan hoon karnay wala bhi nahin, yeh shehar jagah badalta rehta hai, kabhi Shaam mein, kabhi Yaman mein, kabhi Iraq mein, kabhi kahin, kabhi kahin.

Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Tera Rab ghaat mein hai, dekh raha hai, sun raha hai, samajh raha hai, waqt-e-muqarrara par har bure bhale ko neki ki jaza-o-saza de ga. Yeh sab log us ke paas jane wale, tan-tanha us ke samne khade hone wale hain aur woh adl-o-insaf ke sath in mein faisle kare ga aur har shakhs ko poora poora badla de ga jis ka woh mustahiq tha, woh zulm-o-jor se pak hai. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain is se murad tamam makhlooq hai is mein Shaf'a bhi hai aur Witr bhi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke makhlooq Shaf'a aur Allah Witr hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a subah ki namaz hai aur Witr Maghrib ki namaz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a se murad jor-jor aur Witr se murad Allah Azza-o-Jal jaise aasman, zameen, tari, khushki, jinn, ins, suraj, chand waghera. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Aayat (Wazkuro iz ja'alakum khulafa'a mim ba'di qawmi Noohin wa zadakum fil khalqi bastatan fazkuro ala'allahi la'allakum tuflihoon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 69) yani yaad karo ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein qoum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen par khalifa banaya hai aur tumhein jismani quwwat poori tarah di, tumhein chahiye ke Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasadi ban kar na raho. Aur jagah hai ke Aadiyon ne zameen mein nahaq sarkashi ki aur bol uthay ke hum se zyada quwwat wala aur kaun hai? Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.
