Waghairah yeh sab khurafat Bani Israel ki hain in ke bad-deenon ne yeh khud-sakhta riwayat tayyar ki hai taake jahilon mein baatein banayein, Thalabi waghairah ne bayan kiya hai ke ek Aarabi Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamana mein apne gum-shuda oonton ko dhoond raha tha ke jangal bayaban mein us ne isi sifat ka ek shehr dekha aur us mein gaya, ghooma phira, phir logon se aa kar zikr kiya log bhi wahan gaye lekin phir kuch nazar na aaya, Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan aise qisse bahut se lambe chauṛe naql kiye hain yeh hikayat bhi sahih nahin aur agar yeh Aarabi wala qissa sanadan sahih maan lein to mumkin hai ke usey hawas aur khayal ho aur apne khayal mein us ne yeh naqsha jama liya ho aur khayalat ki pukhtagi aur aql ki kami ne usey yaqeen dilaya ho ke woh sahih taur par yehi dekh raha hai aur fil-waqi yun na ho theek isi tarah jo jahil harees aur khayalat ke kach-che hon samajhte hain ke kisi khaas zameen tale sone chandi ke pul hain aur qism qism ke jawahir yaqoot lulu aur moti hain akseer-e-kabeer hai lekin aise chand mawane hain ke wahan log pahunch nahin sakte maslan khazane ke munh par koi azhdaha baitha hai kisi jin ka pehra hai waghairah yeh sab fazool qisse aur banawati baatein hain inhein ghaṛ ghaṛa kar be-waqoofon aur maal ke hareeson ko apne daam mein phans kar in se kuch wasool karne ke liye makkaron ne mashhoor kar rakhe hain phir kabhi chille khainchne ke bahane se kabhi bakhoor ke bahane se kabhi kisi aur tarah se in se yeh makkar rupaye wasool karlete hain aur apna pait paalte hain haan yeh mumkin hai ke zameen mein se jahiliyat ke zamane ka ya Musalmanon ke zamane ka kisi ka gaṛa hua maal nikal aaye to us ka pata jise chal jaye woh us ke hath lag jata hai na wahan koi maar-e-ganj hota hai na koi deo bhoot jin pari jis tarah in logon ne mashhoor kar rakha hai yeh bilkul ghair sahih hai yeh aise hi logon ki khud-sakhta baat hai ya in jaise hi logon se suni sunayi hai Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala naik samajh de. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne bhi farmaya hai ke mumkin hai is se qabila murad ho aur mumkin hai shehr murad ho lekin theek nahin yahan to saaf zahir hota hai ke ek qaum ka zikr hai na ke shehr ka isi liye is ke baad hi Thamudiyon ka zikr kiya ke woh Thamudi jo pattharon ki tarash liya karte thay jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa tanhituna minal jibaali buyutan faariheen) (Surah Al-Shu'ara: 149) yaani tum paharon mein apne kushada aaram-deh makanat apne hathon pattharon mein tarash liya karte ho.

Is ke suboot mein ke is ke ma'ani tarash lene ke hain Arabi sher bhi hain. Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain Samoodi Arab thay, Wadi-ul-Qura mein rehte thay. Aadiyon ka qissa poora poora Surah Al-A'raf mein hum bayan kar chuke hain, ab ia'ada ki zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya mekhon wala Firaun. Autad ke ma'ani Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne lashkaron ke kiye hain jo ke us ke kamon ko mazboot karte rehte thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Firaun gusse ke waqt logon ke hath paon mein mekhain garwa kar marwa dalta tha, chaurang kar ke oopar se bada patthar phenkta tha jis se us ka kachoomar nikal jata tha. Ba'az log kehte hain ke rassiyon aur mekhon waghera se us ke samne khel kiye jate thay. Is ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke us ne apni biwi sahiba ko jo Musalman ho gayi thin, lita kar dono hathon aur dono paon mein mekhain garin, phir bada sa chakki ka patthar un ki peeth par maar kar jaan le li, Allah un par raham kare. Phir farmaya ke in logon ne sarkashi par kamar bandh li thi aur fasadi log thay, logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel jante thay aur har ek ko eeza pahunchate thay. Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ke azab ka kora baras pada. Woh wabaal aaya jo tale na tala, halak-o-barbad aur neest-o-nabood ho gaye. Tera Rab ghaat mein hai, dekh raha hai, sun raha hai, samajh raha hai, waqt-e-muqarrara par har bure bhale ko neki ki jaza-o-saza de ga. Yeh sab log us ke paas jane wale, tan-tanha us ke samne khade hone wale hain aur woh adl-o-insaf ke sath in mein faisle kare ga aur har shakhs ko poora poora badla de ga jis ka woh mustahiq tha, woh zulm-o-jor se pak hai. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Shaf'a aur Witr se kya murad hai aur Qaum-e-Aad ka qissa. Fajr toh har shakhs jaanta hai yani subah aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke Baqar Eid ke din ki subah, aur yeh murad bhi hai ke subah ke waqt ki namaz, aur poora din aur das raaton se murad Zil-Hajj mahine ki pehli das raatein. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke koi ibadat in das dinon ki ibadat se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha Allah ki raah ka jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya yeh bhi nahin magar woh shakhs jo jaan maal le kar nikla aur phir kuch bhi saath le kar na palta. Baaz ne kaha hai Muharram ke pehle das din murad hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan Sharif ke pehle das din lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai yani Zil-Hajj ki shuru ki das raatein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke 'Ashr se murad Eid-ul-Adha ke das din hain aur Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai aur Shaf'a se murad qurbani ka din hai. Iski asnaad mein toh koi muzaiqa nahin lekin matan mein nakarat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Witr se murad Arafah ka din hai yeh nauvin tareekh hoti hai toh Shaf'a se murad dasvin tareekh yani Baqar Eid ka din hai, woh taaq hai yeh juft hai. Hazrat Wasil bin Sa'ib (R.A) ne Hazrat Ata (R.A) se poocha ke kya Witr se murad yahi Witr namaz hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Shaf'a Arafah ka din hai aur Witr Eid-ul-Adha ki raat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) khutba parh rahe thay ke ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Shaf'a kya hai aur Witr kya hai? Aap ne farmaya aayat (فَمَنْ تَعَـجَّلَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203) mein jo do din ka zikr hai woh Shaf'a hai aur 'man ta'akhara' mein jo ek din hai woh Witr hai yani gyarhvin barhvin Zil-Hajj ki Shaf'a aur terhvin Witr hai. Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ka darmiyani din Shaf'a hai aur aakhri din Witr hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam sau naam hain jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai, woh Witr hai, Witr ko dost rakhta hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain is se murad tamam makhlooq hai is mein Shaf'a bhi hai aur Witr bhi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke makhlooq Shaf'a aur Allah Witr hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a subah ki namaz hai aur Witr Maghrib ki namaz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaf'a se murad jor-jor aur Witr se murad Allah Azza-o-Jal jaise aasman, zameen, tari, khushki, jinn, ins, suraj, chand waghera. Quran mein hai aayat (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ko jor-jor paida kiya hai taake tum ibrat hasil kar lo yani jaan lo ke in tamam cheezon ka khaliq Allah Wahid hai jis ka koi shareek nahin. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad ginti hai jis mein juft bhi hai aur taaq bhi hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Shaf'a se murad woh din hain aur Witr se murad teesra din.

Yeh hadith us hadith ke mukhalif hai jo is se pehle guzar chuki hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad namaz hai ke is mein shafa hai jaise subah ki do, zuhr, asr aur isha ki chaar chaar aur witr hai jaise maghrib ki teen raka'atein jo din ke witr hain aur isi tarah aakhri raat ka witr ek marfoo hadith mein mutlaq namaz ke lafz ke sath marwi hai. Ba'az sahaba se farz namaz marwi hai lekin yeh marfoo hadith nahin. Zyada theek yahi maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Wallahu A'alam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne in aath nau aqwal mein se kisi ko faisal qarar nahin diya. Phir farmata hai raat ki qasam jab jaane lage aur yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke jab aane lage, balkay yahi ma'ani zyada munasib aur Wal-Fajr se zyada munasibat rakhte hain. Fajr kehte hain raat ke jaane ko aur din ke aane ko, toh yahan raat ka aana aur din ka jaana murad hoga. Jaise aayat (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ 17 ۙ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ 18 ۙ) (Surah At-Takwir: 17-18) mein. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Muzdalifa ki raat hai. Hijr se murad aql hai, hijr kehte hain rok ko, chunke aql bhi ghalat kariyon aur jhooti baton se rok deti hai is liye ise aql kehte hain.

Hateem ko bhi Hijr-ul-Bait isi liye kehte hain ke woh tawaf karne wale ko Ka'batullah ki shami deewar se rok deta hai. Isi se makhooz hai Hijr-e-Yamama aur isi liye Arab kehte hain Hijr-ul-Hakim 'ala fulan jabke kisi shakhs ko badshah tasarruf se rok de aur kehte hain ke Hijran Mahjoora. Toh farmata hai ke in mein aqal mandon ke liye qabil-e-ibrat qasam hai. Kahin toh qasmein hain ibadaton ki, kahin ibadat ke waqton ki jaise Hajj, namaz waghera ke jin se uske nek banday uska qurb aur uski nazdeki hasil karte hain aur uske samne apni pasti aur khud faramoshi zahir karte hain. Jab in parhezgar nek kar logon ka aur unki aajizi-o-tawazo, khushoo-o-khuzoo ka zikr kiya toh ab unke sath hi unke khilaf jo sarkash aur badkar log hain unka zikr ho raha hai. Toh farmaya hai ke kya tum ne na dekha ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko gharat kar diya jo ke sarkash aur mutakabbir thay, Allah ki nafarmani karte, Rasool ki takzeeb karte aur badiyon par jhuk padte thay. In mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Hood (A.S) aaye thay. Yeh Aad-e-Ula hain jo Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nooh ki aulad mein thay. Allah Ta'ala ne in mein se imandaron ko toh nijat de di aur baqi be-imano ko tez-o-tund khaufnak aur halak aafreen hawaon se halak kiya. Saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh ghazab nak aandhi chalti rahi aur yeh saare ke saare is tarah gharat ho gaye ke unke sar alag thay aur dhad alag thay. In mein se ek bhi baqi na raha jiska mufassal bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Al-Haqqah mein bhi yeh bayan hai. Iram Zatil-Imad, yeh Aad ki tafseer bator atf-e-bayan ke hai taake bakhoobi wazahat ho jaye. Yeh log mazboot aur buland sutonon wale gharon mein rehte thay aur apne zamane mein aur logon se bohat bade tan-o-tosh wale, quwwat-o-taqat wale thay. Isi liye Hazrat Hood (A.S) ne unhein nasihat karte hue farmaya tha. Aayat (Wazkuro iz ja'alakum khulafa'a mim ba'di qawmi Noohin wa zadakum fil khalqi bastatan fazkuro ala'allahi la'allakum tuflihoon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 69) yani yaad karo ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein qoum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen par khalifa banaya hai aur tumhein jismani quwwat poori tarah di, tumhein chahiye ke Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasadi ban kar na raho. Aur jagah hai ke Aadiyon ne zameen mein nahaq sarkashi ki aur bol uthay ke hum se zyada quwwat wala aur kaun hai? Kya woh bhool gaye ke unka paida karne wala unse bohat hi zabardast taqat-o-quwwat wala hai. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke is qabeelay jaise taqatwar aur shehron mein na thay, bade taweel-ul-qamat qawi-ul-jussa thay. Iram unka dar-us-saltanat tha. Inhein sutonon wale kaha jata tha is liye bhi ke yeh log bohat daraz qad thay, balkay sahih wajah yahi hai.

Mislaha ki zameer ka marja' 'imaad' bataya gaya hai, un jaise aur shehron mein na thay, yeh Ahqaaf mein banay huay lambay lambay sutoon thay aur baaz ne zameer ka marja' qabeela bataya hai, yani us qabeelay jaise log aur shehron mein na thay aur yahi qaul theek hai aur agla qaul za'eef hai, isi liye bhi ke yahi muraad hoti toh 'lam yuj'al' kaha jata na ke 'lam yukhlaq'. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Un mein is qadar zor-o-taqat thi ke un mein se koi uthta aur ek badi sari chattan le kar kisi qabeelay par phenk deta toh becharay sab ke sab dab kar mar jatay. Hazrat Thaur bin Zaid Daili farmatay hain ke main ne ek waraq par yeh likha hua parha hai ke main Shaddad bin 'Aad hoon, main ne sutoon buland kiye hain, main ne haath mazboot kiye hain, main ne saat zira' ke khazanay jama kiye hain jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikale gi. Garz khwah yun kaho ke woh umda oonchay aur mazboot makanon walay thay, khwah yun kaho ke woh buland-o-bala sutoonon walay thay, ya yun kaho ke woh behtareen hathiyaron walay thay, ya yun kaho lambay lambay qad walay thay, matlab yeh hai ke ek qaum thi jin ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah Samoodiyon ke sath aa chuka hai, yahan bhi isi tarah 'Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ka dono ka zikr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Baaz hazraat ne yeh bhi kaha ke 'Iram Zaat-il-'Imaad' ek shehar hai, ya toh Damishq ya Iskandariya, lekin yeh qaul theek nahin maloom hota is liye ke ibarat ka theek matlab nahin banta kyunke ya toh yeh badal ho sakta hai ya atf-e-bayan. Dusray is liye bhi ke yahan yeh bayan maqsood hai ke har ek sarkash qabeelay ko Allah ne barbad kiya jin ka naam 'Aadi tha, na ke kisi shehar ko. Main ne is baat ko yahan is liye bayan kar diya hai taake jin mufassireen ki jamaat ne yahan yeh tafseer ki hai, un se koi shakhs dhokay mein na par jaye. Yahan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jo bahut ghareeb hai jis ki sanad mein kalam hai aur sehat mein bhi nazar hai, is mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Momin haq ka qaidi hai. Ae Mu'az! Momin to umeed-o-beem ki halat mein hi rehta hai jab tak ke Pul-e-Sirat se paar na ho jaye.

Aye Mu'az! Momin ko Quran ne bohat si dili khwahishon se rok rakha hai taake woh halakat se bach jaye. Quran is ki daleel hai, khauf is ki hujjat hai, shauq is ki sawari hai, namaz is ki panah hai, roza is ki dhaal hai, sadqa is ka chhutkara hai, sachai is ki ameer hai, sharm is ka wazeer hai aur is ka Rab in sab ke baad is par waqif-o-aagah hai, woh tez nigahon se ise dekh raha hai. Is ke rawi Yunus Allah aur Abu Hamza majhool hain, phir is mein irsal bhi hai, mumkin hai yeh Abu Hamza hi ka kalam ho. Isi Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Ibn-e-Abdul Kala'i ne apne ek wa'z mein kaha: Logo! Jahannam ke saath pul hain, in sab par Pul-e-Sirat hai. Pehle hi pul par log roke jayenge, yahan namaz ka hisab-kitab hoga, yahan se nijat mil gayi to dusre pul par rok hogi, yahan aman-dari ka sawal hoga, jo amanat-dar hoga us ne nijat payi aur jo khayanat wala nikla halak hua. Teesre pul par sila-rehmi ki pursish hogi, is ke kaatne wale yahan se nijat na pa sakenge aur halak honge. Rishtedari yani sila-rehmi wahin majood hogi aur yeh keh rahi hogi ke Allah jis ne mujhe joda to use jod aur jis ne mujhe toda to use tod. Yehi ma'ani hain aayat (Inna Rabbaka La-bil-Mirsaad) (Surah Al-Fajr: 14). Yeh asar itna hi hai, pura nahin.

Wus'at-e-rizq ko ikram na samjho balkay imtehan samjho. Matlab yeh hai ke jo log wus'at aur kushadgi pa kar yun samajh baithtay hain ke Allah ne un ka ikram kiya yeh ghalat hai balkay darasal yeh imtehan hai. Jaise aur jagah hai "A-yahsabuna annama numidduhum" (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 55) kh. Yani maal-o-aulad ke barh janay ko yeh log nekiyon ki ziyadati samajhtay hain darasal yeh un ki besamjhi hai. Isi tarah is ke bar-aks bhi yani tang-turshi ko insan apni ihanat samajh baithta hai halankay darasal yeh bhi Allah ki taraf se aazmaish hai. Isi liye yahan "Kalla" keh kar in dono khayalat ki tardeed ki ke yeh waqia nahin, jisay Allah maal ki wus'at de us se woh khush hai aur jis par tangi karay us se na-khush hai, balkay khushi aur na-khushi ka madar in dono halaton mein amal par hai. Ghani ho kar shukr-guzari karay to Allah ka mehboob aur faqir ho kar sabr karay to Allah ka mehboob. Allah Ta'ala is tarah aur us tarah aazmata hai. Phir yateem ki izzat karnay ka hukum diya, hadith mein hai ke sab se achha ghar woh hai jis mein yateem ho aur us ki achhi parwarish ho rahi ho aur badtareen ghar woh hai jis mein yateem ho aur us se bad-sulooki ki jati ho. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ungli utha kar farmaya main aur yateem ka palnay wala jannat mein is tarah honge yani qareeb qareeb. Abu Dawood ki hadith mein hai ke kalma ki aur beech ki ungli mila kar unhein dikhaya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur yateem ka palnay wala jannat mein is tarah honge. Phir farmaya ke yeh log faqiron, maskeenon ke sath sulook-e-ehsan karnay, unhein khana peena denay ki ek dusray ko raghbat-o-lalach nahin dilatay aur yeh aib bhi in mein hai ke meeras ka maal halal-o-haram hazam kar jatay hain aur maal ki mohabbat bhi in mein behad hai.

Sajdon ki barkatein: Qayamat ke holnak halaat ka bayan ho raha hai ke bil-yaqeen us din zameen past kar di jayegi, unchi neechi zameen barabar kar di jayegi aur bilkul saaf hamwar ho jayegi. Pahar zameen ke barabar kar diye jayenge. Tamam makhlooq qabr se nikal aayegi. Khud Allah Ta'ala makhlooq ke faisle karne ke liye aa jayega. Yeh us aam shafa'at ke baad jo tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hogi aur yeh shafa'at us waqt hogi jabke tamam makhlooq ek ek bade bade paighambar (A.S) ke paas ho aayegi aur har Nabi keh dega ke main is qabil nahin. Phir sab ke sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayenge aur aap farmayenge ke haan haan main is ke liye tayyar hoon. Phir aap jayenge aur Allah ke samne sifarish karenge ke woh Parwardigar logon ke darmiyan faisle karne ke liye tashreef laye. Yehi pehli shafa'at hai aur yehi woh Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jis ka mufassal bayan Surah Subhan mein guzar chuka hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Alameen faisle ke liye tashreef layega, us ke aane ki kaifiyat wohi jaanta hai. Farishtay bhi us ke aage aage saf-basta hazir honge. Jahannam bhi layi jayegi. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jahannam ki us roz sattar hazar lagamein hongi, har lagam par sattar hazar farishtay honge jo use ghaseet rahe honge. Yehi riwayat khud Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. Us din insaan apne naye purane tamam aamal ko yaad karne lagega, buraiyon par pachtayega, nekiyon ke na karne ya kam karne par afsos karega, gunahon par nadim hoga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar koi banda apne paida hone se lekar marte dam tak sajde mein pada rahe aur Allah ka pura itaat-guzar rahe phir bhi apni is ibadat ko Qayamat ke din haqeer aur na-cheez samjhega aur chahega ke agar main duniya ki taraf lautaya jaun to ajr-o-sawab ka kaam aur zyada karun. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke us din Allah ke azab jaisa azab kisi aur ka na hoga.

Jo woh apne nafarman aur nafarjam bandon ko karega na us jaisi zabardast pakar aur qaid-o-band kisi ki hosakti hai. Zabaniya farishtay badtareen beriyan aur hathkariyan unhein pehnaye hue honge. Yeh toh hua badbakhton ka anjam, ab nek-bakhton ka haal suniye jo roohein sukoon aur itminan wali hain, paak aur sabit hain, haq ki sathi hain. Unse maut ke waqt aur qabr se uthne ke waqt kaha jayega ke tu apne Rab ki taraf, uske paros ki taraf, uske sawab aur ajar ki taraf, uski jannat aur razamandi ki taraf laut chal. Yeh Allah se khush hai aur Allah is se raazi hai aur itna dega ke yeh bhi khush ho jayegi. Toh mere khaas bandon mein aa ja aur meri jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Buraida farmate hain Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Hazrat Abdullah se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din itminan wali roohon se kaha jayega ke tu apne Rab yani apne jism ki taraf laut ja jise tu duniya mein aabad kiye hue thi, tum dono aapas mein ek dusre se raazi-o-razamand ho. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah is aayat ko 'Fadkhuli fi ibadi' parhte the yani ae rooh mere bande mein yani uske jism mein chali ja, lekin yeh ghareeb hai aur zahir qaul pehla hi hai, jaise aur jagah hai 'Summa ruddu ilallahi maulahumul haq' yani phir sab ke sab apne sachay Maula ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Aur jagah hai 'Wa inna ilaina la-marj'un' yani hamara lautna Allah ki taraf yani uske hukm ki taraf aur uske samne hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh aayatein Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ki maujudgi mein utrein toh aapne kaha kitna achha qaul hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhein bhi yahi kaha jayega. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ne yeh aayatein parhein toh Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne yeh farmaya jis par aapne yeh khushkhabri sunayi ke tujhe farishta maut ke waqt yahi kahega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yeh riwayat bhi hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) mufassir-ul-Quran ka Taif mein inteqal hua toh ek parinda aaya jis tarah ka parinda kabhi zameen par dekha nahin gaya, woh naash mein chala gaya phir nikalte hue dekha gaya. Jab aapko dafan kardiya gaya toh qabr ke kone se isi aayat ki tilawat ki aawaz aayi aur yeh na maloom hosaka ke kaun parh raha hai. Yeh riwayat Tabrani mein bhi hai. Abu Hashim Qanat bin Zarrin (R.H) farmate hain ke jang-e-Room mein hum dushmanon ke haath qaid hogaye. Shah-e-Room ne hamein apne samne bulaya aur kaha ya toh tum is deen ko chhor do ya qatl hona manzoor karlo. Ek ek ko woh yeh kehta ke hamara deen qabool karo warna jallad ko hukm deta hoon ke tumhari gardan mare. Teen shakhs toh murtad hogaye, jab chautha aaya toh usne saaf inkar kiya, badshah ke hukm se uski gardan uda di gayi aur sar ko nehar mein daal diya gaya. Woh neeche doob gaya aur zara si der mein upar aa gaya aur un teenon ki taraf dekhne laga ke ae falaan aur ae falaan aur ae falaan, unke naam le kar unhein aawaz di. Jab yeh mutawajja hue, sab darbari log bhi dekh rahe the aur khud badshah bhi ta'ajjub ke saath sun raha tha. Us musalman shaheed ke sar ne kaha suno Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Ya ayyatuhan nafsul mutma'innah. Irji'i ila Rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyah. Fadkhuli fi ibadi. Wadkhuli jannati." Itna keh kar woh sar phir paani mein ghota laga gaya. Is waqiye ka itna achha asar hua ke qareeb tha ke Nasrani usi waqt musalman ho jate. Badshah ne usi waqt darbar barkhast karadiya aur woh teenon phir musalman hogaye aur hum sab yunhi qaid mein rahe, aakhir Khalifa Abu Jafar Mansoor ki taraf fidiya aa gaya aur humne nijat payi. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs se kaha yeh dua parha kar: "Allahumma inni as'aluka nafsan bika mutma'innatan tu'minu bi-liqa'ika wa tarda bi-qada'ika wa taqna'u bi-'ata'ika." Ilahi main tujh se aisa nafs talab karta hoon jo teri zaat par itminan aur bharosa rakhta ho, teri mulaqat par imaan rakhta ho, teri qaza par raazi ho, tere diye hue par qana'at karne wala ho. Surah Al-Fajr ki tafsir khatam hui.

Phir Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke us din Allah ke azab jaisa azab kisi aur ka na hoga.

Yeh toh hua badbakhton ka anjam, ab nek-bakhton ka haal suniye jo roohein sukoon aur itminan wali hain, paak aur sabit hain, haq ki sathi hain. Unse maut ke waqt aur qabr se uthne ke waqt kaha jayega ke tu apne Rab ki taraf, uske paros ki taraf, uske sawab aur ajar ki taraf, uski jannat aur razamandi ki taraf laut chal. Yeh Allah se khush hai aur Allah is se raazi hai aur itna dega ke yeh bhi khush ho jayegi. Toh mere khaas bandon mein aa ja aur meri jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Buraida farmate hain Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Hazrat Abdullah se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din itminan wali roohon se kaha jayega ke tu apne Rab yani apne jism ki taraf laut ja jise tu duniya mein aabad kiye hue thi, tum dono aapas mein ek dusre se raazi-o-razamand ho. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah is aayat ko 'Fadkhuli fi ibadi' parhte the yani ae rooh mere bande mein yani uske jism mein chali ja, lekin yeh ghareeb hai aur zahir qaul pehla hi hai, jaise aur jagah hai 'Summa ruddu ilallahi maulahumul haq' yani phir sab ke sab apne sachay Maula ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Aur jagah hai 'Wa inna ilaina la-marj'un' yani hamara lautna Allah ki taraf yani uske hukm ki taraf aur uske samne hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh aayatein Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ki maujudgi mein utrein toh aapne kaha kitna achha qaul hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhein bhi yahi kaha jayega. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ne yeh aayatein parhein toh Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne yeh farmaya jis par aapne yeh khushkhabri sunayi ke tujhe farishta maut ke waqt yahi kahega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yeh riwayat bhi hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) mufassir-ul-Quran ka Taif mein inteqal hua toh ek parinda aaya jis tarah ka parinda kabhi zameen par dekha nahin gaya, woh naash mein chala gaya phir nikalte hue dekha gaya. Jab aapko dafan kardiya gaya toh qabr ke kone se isi aayat ki tilawat ki aawaz aayi aur yeh na maloom hosaka ke kaun parh raha hai. Yeh riwayat Tabrani mein bhi hai. Abu Hashim Qanat bin Zarrin (R.H) farmate hain ke jang-e-Room mein hum dushmanon ke haath qaid hogaye. Shah-e-Room ne hamein apne samne bulaya aur kaha ya toh tum is deen ko chhor do ya qatl hona manzoor karlo. Ek ek ko woh yeh kehta ke hamara deen qabool karo warna jallad ko hukm deta hoon ke tumhari gardan mare. Teen shakhs toh murtad hogaye, jab chautha aaya toh usne saaf inkar kiya, badshah ke hukm se uski gardan uda di gayi aur sar ko nehar mein daal diya gaya. Woh neeche doob gaya aur zara si der mein upar aa gaya aur un teenon ki taraf dekhne laga ke ae falaan aur ae falaan aur ae falaan, unke naam le kar unhein aawaz di. Jab yeh mutawajja hue, sab darbari log bhi dekh rahe the aur khud badshah bhi ta'ajjub ke saath sun raha tha. Us musalman shaheed ke sar ne kaha suno Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Ya ayyatuhan nafsul mutma'innah. Irji'i ila Rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyah. Fadkhuli fi ibadi. Wadkhuli jannati." Itna keh kar woh sar phir paani mein ghota laga gaya. Is waqiye ka itna achha asar hua ke qareeb tha ke Nasrani usi waqt musalman ho jate. Badshah ne usi waqt darbar barkhast karadiya aur woh teenon phir musalman hogaye aur hum sab yunhi qaid mein rahe, aakhir Khalifa Abu Jafar Mansoor ki taraf fidiya aa gaya aur humne nijat payi. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs se kaha yeh dua parha kar: "Allahumma inni as'aluka nafsan bika mutma'innatan tu'minu bi-liqa'ika wa tarda bi-qada'ika wa taqna'u bi-'ata'ika." Ilahi main tujh se aisa nafs talab karta hoon jo teri zaat par itminan aur bharosa rakhta ho, teri mulaqat par imaan rakhta ho, teri qaza par raazi ho, tere diye hue par qana'at karne wala ho. Surah Al-Fajr ki tafsir khatam hui.

Yeh Allah se khush hai aur Allah is se raazi hai aur itna dega ke yeh bhi khush ho jayegi. Toh mere khaas bandon mein aa ja aur meri jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Buraida farmate hain Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Hazrat Abdullah se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din itminan wali roohon se kaha jayega ke tu apne Rab yani apne jism ki taraf laut ja jise tu duniya mein aabad kiye hue thi, tum dono aapas mein ek dusre se raazi-o-razamand ho. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah is aayat ko 'Fadkhuli fi ibadi' parhte the yani ae rooh mere bande mein yani uske jism mein chali ja, lekin yeh ghareeb hai aur zahir qaul pehla hi hai, jaise aur jagah hai 'Summa ruddu ilallahi maulahumul haq' yani phir sab ke sab apne sachay Maula ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Aur jagah hai 'Wa inna ilaina la-marj'un' yani hamara lautna Allah ki taraf yani uske hukm ki taraf aur uske samne hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh aayatein Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ki maujudgi mein utrein toh aapne kaha kitna achha qaul hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhein bhi yahi kaha jayega. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ne yeh aayatein parhein toh Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne yeh farmaya jis par aapne yeh khushkhabri sunayi ke tujhe farishta maut ke waqt yahi kahega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yeh riwayat bhi hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) mufassir-ul-Quran ka Taif mein inteqal hua toh ek parinda aaya jis tarah ka parinda kabhi zameen par dekha nahin gaya, woh naash mein chala gaya phir nikalte hue dekha gaya. Jab aapko dafan kardiya gaya toh qabr ke kone se isi aayat ki tilawat ki aawaz aayi aur yeh na maloom hosaka ke kaun parh raha hai. Yeh riwayat Tabrani mein bhi hai. Abu Hashim Qanat bin Zarrin (R.H) farmate hain ke jang-e-Room mein hum dushmanon ke haath qaid hogaye. Shah-e-Room ne hamein apne samne bulaya aur kaha ya toh tum is deen ko chhor do ya qatl hona manzoor karlo. Ek ek ko woh yeh kehta ke hamara deen qabool karo warna jallad ko hukm deta hoon ke tumhari gardan mare. Teen shakhs toh murtad hogaye, jab chautha aaya toh usne saaf inkar kiya, badshah ke hukm se uski gardan uda di gayi aur sar ko nehar mein daal diya gaya. Woh neeche doob gaya aur zara si der mein upar aa gaya aur un teenon ki taraf dekhne laga ke ae falaan aur ae falaan aur ae falaan, unke naam le kar unhein aawaz di. Jab yeh mutawajja hue, sab darbari log bhi dekh rahe the aur khud badshah bhi ta'ajjub ke saath sun raha tha. Us musalman shaheed ke sar ne kaha suno Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Ya ayyatuhan nafsul mutma'innah. Irji'i ila Rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyah. Fadkhuli fi ibadi. Wadkhuli jannati." Itna keh kar woh sar phir paani mein ghota laga gaya. Is waqiye ka itna achha asar hua ke qareeb tha ke Nasrani usi waqt musalman ho jate. Badshah ne usi waqt darbar barkhast karadiya aur woh teenon phir musalman hogaye aur hum sab yunhi qaid mein rahe, aakhir Khalifa Abu Jafar Mansoor ki taraf fidiya aa gaya aur humne nijat payi. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs se kaha yeh dua parha kar: "Allahumma inni as'aluka nafsan bika mutma'innatan tu'minu bi-liqa'ika wa tarda bi-qada'ika wa taqna'u bi-'ata'ika." Ilahi main tujh se aisa nafs talab karta hoon jo teri zaat par itminan aur bharosa rakhta ho, teri mulaqat par imaan rakhta ho, teri qaza par raazi ho, tere diye hue par qana'at karne wala ho. Surah Al-Fajr ki tafsir khatam hui.

Pahar zameen ke barabar kar diye jayenge. Tamam makhlooq qabr se nikal aayegi. Khud Allah Ta'ala makhlooq ke faisle karne ke liye aa jayega. Yeh us aam shafa'at ke baad jo tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hogi aur yeh shafa'at us waqt hogi jabke tamam makhlooq ek ek bade bade paighambar (A.S) ke paas ho aayegi aur har Nabi keh dega ke main is qabil nahin. Phir sab ke sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayenge aur aap farmayenge ke haan haan main is ke liye tayyar hoon. Phir aap jayenge aur Allah ke samne sifarish karenge ke woh Parwardigar logon ke darmiyan faisle karne ke liye tashreef laye. Yehi pehli shafa'at hai aur yehi woh Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jis ka mufassal bayan Surah Subhan mein guzar chuka hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Alameen faisle ke liye tashreef layega, us ke aane ki kaifiyat wohi jaanta hai. Farishtay bhi us ke aage aage saf-basta hazir honge. Jahannam bhi layi jayegi. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jahannam ki us roz sattar hazar lagamein hongi, har lagam par sattar hazar farishtay honge jo use ghaseet rahe honge. Yehi riwayat khud Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. Us din insaan apne naye purane tamam aamal ko yaad karne lagega, buraiyon par pachtayega, nekiyon ke na karne ya kam karne par afsos karega, gunahon par nadim hoga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar koi banda apne paida hone se lekar marte dam tak sajde mein pada rahe aur Allah ka pura itaat-guzar rahe phir bhi apni is ibadat ko Qayamat ke din haqeer aur na-cheez samjhega aur chahega ke agar main duniya ki taraf lautaya jaun to ajr-o-sawab ka kaam aur zyada karun. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke us din Allah ke azab jaisa azab kisi aur ka na hoga.
